incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in fire, with flames visibly coming from the roof and front door, and smoke rising. The house has light-colored siding and a porch.

observations.description: Large, bright orange flames are visible bursting from the roof and through the front door, with fire also evident inside the porch area.
Smoke is visible rising from the roof and around the fire area, particularly near the porch.
Roof is partially consumed by fire, with visible charred sections and sagging. Porch and door area have significant fire damage.
House has a porch with columns and an attached side structure. A white door is visible on the right, partially damaged. A chimney is visible in the background.
Trees and green foliage are visible in the background, suggesting a residential or suburban setting.
No vehicles are visible in the image.
No people are visible in the image.
